newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's insurance turnover at $806 million in '96.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's insurance turnover at $806 million in '96.

text.p: Morocco's insurance market posted a turnover of 7.617 billion dirhams ($806 million) in 1996, a nine percent increase over the year before, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement sent to Reuters that car insurance accounted for 40 percent of the overall figure.
The sector's assets reached 3.566 billion dirhams in 1996 from 1.526 billion dirhams the previous year. The ministry attributed the rise to reserves funded by capital gains realised in 1995.
The statement said however that two out of the 19 operating insurance firms were in deficit and registered losses totalling 254.9 million dirhams in 1996.
The sector's overall financial situation had improved in comparison with 1994 when nearly all credit indicators were negative, it added.
